messages:
Kelsey: Quick sync — aligning hero + webinar CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. We need a tight onramp, benchmark callouts, and clear routing for signups. Thoughts?

Ravi: +1. Prioritize conversion paths: demo -> webinar -> eval. Also need lead-gating rules and explicit CTAs by deployment mode.

Maya: Drafted microcopy options to keep tone product-led and short. Quick variants: 
```
Hosted: "Hosted API — launch faster, scale predictably. Start for free."
Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity — predictable throughput, enterprise SLAs."
Private: "Private deployment — VPC & on‑prem for regulated data."
```
Subhead for benchmark callout: "Up to 3x throughput at 30% lower per-token cost vs standard deployments."

Sam: I'll fold these into the page draft. Proposed hero CTA mapping:
- Primary: "Get started" (free credits) -> Hosted signup
- Secondary: "Request capacity" -> Dedicated sales form
- Tertiary: "Talk to sales" -> Private enterprise form

Noah: Inbound routing rules (proposal):
```
if cta == "Request capacity" OR company_size >= 100 => route: enterprise-sdr
else if cta == "Talk to sales" => route: account-exec
else => marketing-nurture
```
Keep small teams on one-click signup funnel.

Maya: Webinar tie-in for hero banner: "Join our benchmarking webinar — see real app latencies & cost tradeoffs." CTA: "Reserve your seat" -> lightweight form with optional company_size + expected_rps fields. Small teams can RSVP without company_size.

Kelsey: For the benchmarks section we want two layers: stat cards + an expandable deep-dive modal. Example stat cards: "p95 latency < 200ms", "Cost per 1k tokens: $X" — use conservative numbers for the public page.

preview-bot: deploy-preview created: https://preview.redwood.ai/pages/landing-1769345600

Ravi: A/B plan — run hero headline A/B for 2 weeks, track demo CTR and webinar RSVPs. Success thresholds: +8% demo conversion OR +12% webinar RSVP.

Sam: I'll create copy tickets and update the content board. Tagging @Noah to finalise routing schema and webhook fields.

Kelsey: Can we ship the updated page + webinar signup by Tue EOD? I'll draft the brief here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/landing-onramp-draft (draft).

Maya: On SEO metas — propose:
Title: "Redwood Inference — Hosted API, Dedicated GPUs, Private Deployments"
Meta desc: "Ship low-latency LLM features with predictable costs. Hosted API, reserved capacity, and private deployments for regulated workloads."

Noah: I'll mock the webhook payload for the routing rules once Sam posts the required fields.

Sam: Added QA checklist to the content board: analytics tags, CTA targets, form validation, and GTM events.

Kelsey: Perfect — thanks all :thumbsup:
